Jane_Corp: Hey team — noticed a bunch of objects for customer_id=acme_42 are still searchable even though TTL expired 2026-03-02. Can you confirm deletion timeline and whether they're on legal hold?
Alex (support): Sorry to hear that. Can you paste a couple of object IDs and the index/query you used? Also which region?
Jane_Corp: region=us-west-2. Sample IDs: obj_9a7c, obj_9a8d, obj_9a9f. Query: `SELECT id, deleted_at FROM objects WHERE customer_id='acme_42' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10;` — returns rows with deleted_at set but still showing in search results.
infra-bot: retention-worker: job run completed 2026-03-09T14:02:07Z; deleted=12k; queued=180
Alex (support): Thanks — looking. Lina, noticed any retention-worker backlogs or KMS errors around early March?
Lina (sre): We rotated the kms key for the tenant on 2026-03-01 03:12 UTC (key: redwood-usw2-rot-03). Retention-worker logs show transient decrypt errors between 03:12–03:45 UTC: 
```
2026-03-01T03:15:12Z error decrypt object=obj_9a8d err=KMS:AccessDenied
2026-03-01T03:16:07Z warn tombstone created but object not purged id=obj_9a8d
```
But overall worker retried; backlog cleared next day.
Ryan (eng): That pattern can leave tombstone records where the index still surfaces documents if the deletion step failed after tombstone creation. Quick repro: run `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood/v1/internal/object-status?ids=obj_9a8d"` — will return retention_state and tombstone_id.
Jane_Corp: ran that, response: `{"id":"obj_9a8d","retention_state":"tombstoned","tombstone_id":"ts-20260301-0316","searchable":true}`
Maya (legal): Quick question — has the customer requested any legal hold or export in Feb/Mar? If so we should not purge.
Alex (support): I checked intake — no active legal hold for acme_42. No pending hold requests.
Lina (sre): Ok. Looks like KMS rotate caused a short-lived AccessDenied that prevented object decrypt+final-delete, leaving tombstone rows and index entries. We need: (1) audit log export for the affected timeframe, (2) trigger targeted purge for tombstoned ids, (3) confirm no legal hold.
Ryan (eng): For the targeted purge, I can run the reaper with `--id-list` and `--force-retry`. Command: `./RetentionReaper --ids obj_9a7c,obj_9a8d,obj_9a9f --region usw2 --force-retry --log-level debug` — this will re-run deletion with fresh KMS context. Will report success/failure.
Alex (support): Jane, are you OK with us running the targeted purge now? We'll also provide an export of audit events for 2026-03-01 02:50–04:00 UTC.
Jane_Corp: yes please do the purge. We need confirmation once objects are no longer returned by searches and a full audit bundle.
infra-bot: audit-export: job queued id=audit-2034567890-1 timeframe=2026-03-01T02:50:00Z/2026-03-01T04:00:00Z
Lina (sre): Kicking off reaper now, running under service account `svc-retention-retry`. Will relay logs.
Ryan (eng): Reaper output (snippet): 
```
[INFO] attempting final-delete id=obj_9a8d
[INFO] kms decrypt success for tombstone ts-20260301-0316
[INFO] final-delete succeeded id=obj_9a8d
[DEBUG] index prune request sent for id=obj_9a8d
```
All three sample IDs reported success.
Alex (support): Ran the search query again and now `SELECT id, deleted_at FROM objects WHERE customer_id='acme_42'` returns deleted_at but search API does not return those objects. Confirming with Jane.
Jane_Corp: I re-ran search — objs not returned anymore. Thanks. Can you share the audit export link and a short RCA?
Maya (legal): For the RCA: root cause = KMS key rotation caused transient AccessDenied errors during deletion worker, leaving objects tombstoned but not fully purged. Impact = a small set of objects (estimated <200) temporarily visible after TTL. Remediation = forced re-run of retention reaper and audit export provided. Recommend we add a post-rotate retention-worker quickpass to avoid this class of failures.
Alex (support): Audit export ready: https://internal-exports.redwood/audit/audit-2034567890-1.zip (contains event list, worker logs, and tombstone ids).
Lina (sre): I'll schedule a follow-up: add a post-KMS-rotation retention check in the rotation playbook + alert if tombstones > 0 after rotation. Filing ENG-rotation-457.
Ryan (eng): I'll add a small retry-window in the reaper to catch AccessDenied and re-auth automatically.
Jane_Corp: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Please include a short SLA note for customers about potential 1–2 hour visibility windows during key rotations.
Alex (support): Noted — prepping customer email and will CC legal. Closing this thread after export delivery and RFC created. :thumbsup:
